propositions: Version 0.13.0 must be declared consistently in pyproject.toml, server.json (top-level and all packages[] entries), and uv.lock with uv lock --check validation.
CHANGELOG.md must have a hand-curated [0.13.0] section dated 2026-08-28 with correct compare links and a fresh [Unreleased] section.
All pre-commit guards (version-lockstep, lint, typecheck, full test suite, build, twine check) must pass before release commit.
Release commit requires DCO sign-off, Gerrit Change-Id, and rebar-ticket trailer; must obtain LLM-Review +1, Verified +1, and no unresolved comments before Gerrit submit to main.

Release dispatch from main with version=0.13.0 requires pypi environment approval and all release.yml jobs to succeed; published artifacts must pass PyPI attestation, GitHub tag/release, MCP Registry, and Homebrew tap verification.
Fresh channel install of nava-rebar[mcp]==0.13.0 must pass scripts/probe_rebar.py probe with zero failures.
